description: Published GitHub Releases, including prereleases and source-only previews. Unreleased branches are not releases.

releases.name: MayOS 0.5.2-pre3 — 现代硬件试用
releases.body:
## MayOS 0.5.2-pre3 · 现代 x86-64 硬件试用

- MayKernel64 新增直连 xHCI 根端口的 USB Boot Protocol 键盘与相对移动鼠标输入，保留 PS/2 路径。
- xHCI 与 NVMe 可访问 UEFI 分配在 64 GiB 以上的 PCI MMIO。MayShell 的 hardware 命令显示设备识别结果。
- 启动菜单新增 Test hardware (RAM only)，桌面可用，文件只存在于内存会话。

QEMU Q35/OVMF 禁用 PS/2 后通过双 xHCI 控制器测试、USB 键盘重连、NVMe 写入冷启动读回以及从 GPT NVMe 硬盘启动并用 USB 完成首次设置。RAM-only 试用前后的 SATA 和 NVMe 镜像 SHA-256 一致。传统 BIOS/PS/2 输入也通过回归。

录屏为 QEMU 虚拟机实录。实体机型号、多品牌固件、Secure Boot、集线器、I²C 触摸板和 4Kn 存储仍待验证。

- [MayKernel64 启动 ISO · 23.86 MiB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhongYeMay/MayOS/a180faedb32c040d3c5a27ac0c6b504b6bf2c877/MayOS-0.5.2-pre3-MayKernel-x86_64.iso)
- [现代硬件适配 QEMU 实录](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZhongYeMay/MayOS/a180faedb32c040d3c5a27ac0c6b504b6bf2c877/MayOS-0.5.2-pre3-hardware-QEMU.mp4)

releases.name: MayOS 0.5.2-pre2 — 中日韩输入与新版安装器
releases.body:
## MayOS 0.5.2-pre2 · 中日韩输入与新版安装器

- 在文本编辑器、新建文件或重命名对话框按 F3 切换输入。首批输入法包含全拼、注音、日语罗马字转平假名或片假名、韩语两套式及 Unicode 码点输入。
- 编辑器和 MayFS 文件名使用 UTF‑8。预览支持四字节字符、常见组合字符的整组退格、BOM 显示和 CRLF 换行。
- 安装器沿用 MayOS 深色界面。按 F4 切换中英文。安装前核对目标磁盘、容量和操作，安装中显示实际扫描、写入与回读进度。

QEMU 验证了双内核输入、MayKernel64 冷启动读回、完整的 UEFI 安装和非空盘拒绝写入。发布包包含 MayKernel64 启动 ISO 与离线安装 ISO。测试建议使用独立虚拟磁盘并关闭 Secure Boot。

拼音和注音使用离线词表，注音按无调音节匹配。日语汉字转换覆盖常用词，字库之外的字符使用替代符显示。

releases.body:
## MayOS 0.5.2-pre1 · 八种界面语言

- MayKernel64 的首次开机支持简体中文、繁體中文、英语、日语、韩语、西班牙语、法语和德语。可用方向键或鼠标选择，确认后后续页面随即切换。
- 桌面上的「设置 → 语言与地区」可应用或撤销语言选择。桌面菜单、设置导航和文件管理器的基本控件随显示语言切换。
- 已安装的 MayKernel64 会将语言写入独立的 MayFS 记录。旧版文件和其他偏好可继续读取。

附件提供 MayKernel64 启动 ISO。BIOS 启动、UEFI 硬盘首次开机、冷启动语言恢复和旧版 MayFS 兼容已在 QEMU 验证。语言选择也在 Linux64 开发构建中通过会话内测试。

图形安装器翻译、地区格式、输入法、从右到左排版和完整语言目录仍在开发。运行要求为 x86_64，UEFI 测试时请关闭 Secure Boot。使用附件中的 SHA-256 校验清单核对下载文件。

releases.name: MayOS 0.5.1-pre1 — 图形安装与首次开机
releases.body:
## 0.5.1 开发预览

- 图形安装器支持选盘、确认、写入和读回校验。可将 MayKernel64 离线安装到空白 GPT 硬盘。
- 插入新版安装镜像后可试启动新内核，测试后确认升级或保留原版本。QEMU 测试验证了升级前后 MayFS 内容逐字节一致。
- 首次开机参考 MayDOS 的分步流程，包含简体中文、MIT 许可、MayShell 用户名、手动更新说明与深浅外观。用户名和外观会保存到 MayFS。

ISO 在 QEMU 的 BIOS 与 x86-64 UEFI 模式下启动通过，安装后的硬盘启动在 UEFI 下验证。测试时请关闭 Secure Boot，并使用专用空白磁盘。物理机兼容性待验证。

下载后可使用 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 校验 ISO。

[QEMU 回归测试与截图](https://github.com/ZhongYeMay/MayOS/actions/runs/44895359541)

releases.name: MayOS 0.5.0-pre2 — MayKernel 驱动预览
releases.body:
## MayOS 0.5.0-pre2 · MayKernel 驱动预览

本次发布提供 MayKernel x86_64 独立 ISO。GRUB 启动镜像已通过 QEMU BIOS 和 OVMF UEFI 回归，建议在虚拟机中使用独立测试磁盘。

- AHCI SATA 和 NVMe 接入 MayFS，已验证写入、缓存刷新和冷启动读回。旧 IDE/ATA 路径也通过回归。
- RTL8139、E1000 和 E1000e 共用 MayKernel 的轮询网络栈。QEMU 验证了 ARP、DHCP、DNS、UDP 回显和 TCP 重传。
- ACPI/PCIe 枚举、xHCI 端口检测和 HDA 编解码器探测已通过混合硬件拓扑测试。
- 此版本包含签名更新开发线的代码。隔离 ATA 更新诊断覆盖 64 KiB 写盘、重启后复验与篡改拒绝。该诊断使用专用构建。

USB 键鼠输入、VirtIO-net、HDA 音频播放和在线更新安装仍在开发。实体机与 Secure Boot 兼容性有待验证。

下载 ISO、源码或 QEMU 桌面截图后，可用 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 校验文件。Linux 双内核体验可使用现有的 [0.5.0-pre1 双内核镜像](https://github.com/ZhongYeMay/MayOS/releases/tag/v0.5.0-pre1)。

releases.name: MayOS 0.5.0-pre1 — premium monochrome UI, MayKernel64 + Linux64
releases.body:
# MayOS 0.5.0-pre1 — verified premium monochrome UI

Experimental QEMU-tested preview, not a stable daily-use OS.

- New native black/charcoal desktop, thin-outline windows, floating
  Dock, antialiased rounded cards and redesigned About MayOS.
- Native 64-bit MayKernel and Linux 7.3.1 dual-boot via BIOS/UEFI GRUB.
- MayFS dual snapshots, cold-boot recovery, simulated QEMU power-cut
  durability tests and disk-capacity protection.
- Two genuine QEMU walkthroughs with iPhone-compatible H.264 Baseline
  MP4 copies for easier streaming. Original recordings and their
  SHA256 metadata are also retained.
- Exactly built and validated ISO files, genuine screenshot, source
  archive and SHA256SUMS for independent verification.

QEMU testing does not mean physical-PC support or complete USB, GPU,
NVMe, Wi-Fi, networking, Secure Boot or production filesystem safety.
Only use isolated test disks. Historical releases are not replaced.

releases.name: MayOS 0.4.1-pre2 — verified strict-reference UI, MayKernel64 / Linux64
releases.body:
# MayOS 0.4.1-pre2 — user's strict-reference desktop UI

The actual 1024×768 user-supplied screenshot, not a generic macOS
theme, is the visual specification. The previous native desktop layout
was restored and the original Google Material Symbols Rounded glyph
rasterizer and layered MD3 window controls returned. Defaults are
restrained black/gray rather than purple. The 64-bit OS keeps its
settings, six optional accent choices, MayFS persistence, pointer
sizes, square black/white and custom P3-image cursors.

Both ISOs are tested QEMU BIOS/UEFI builds of this exact commit:
- MayKernel ELF64 x86_64 ISO.
- MayKernel ELF64 + independent Linux 7.3.1 x86_64 dual ISO.

Release assets include exact QEMU framebuffer screenshots, two
unedited real QEMU MP4 walkthroughs, machine-readable run metadata,
source code and SHA-256 checksums.

**Limitations**: QEMU is verified, not arbitrary physical PCs.
Secure Boot, IA32 UEFI, broad GPU/USB/NVMe drivers, modern HTTPS
browser and general Wi-Fi hardware support are not guaranteed.
Do not rely on this research OS for important data.

releases.name: MayOS 0.4.1-pre1 — native MayKernel64 / Linux x86_64
releases.body:
# MayOS 0.4.1-pre1 — MayKernel64

This preview contains a **genuine native x86_64 MayKernel ELF64**
built using a 32-bit Multiboot entry trampoline that switches the CPU
to x86_64 long mode before executing its C core and original GUI.

- **Dual-boot ISO:** MayKernel64 and independent Linux 7.3.1 x86_64.
- **MayKernel ISO:** dedicated x86_64 native kernel with GUI and MayFS.
- Legacy BIOS x64 and x64 UEFI tested with actual QEMU/OVMF boots.
- PS/2 input, MayFS cold-boot data recovery and Linux isolation tested.
- Initial 64 GiB identity-mapped physical address window for firmware
  framebuffers; early allocator still limited to the first 128 MiB.
- 32-bit-only CPUs no longer supported by MayKernel.

Check SHA-256 hashes before using either ISO. The matching source ZIP,
QEMU screenshot and machine-readable test reports are attached.

**Limits:** Secure Boot disabled; IA32 UEFI, ARM, physical PCs, general
GPU/USB/NVMe/Wi-Fi drivers and arbitrary firmware have NOT been verified.
This is a research preview, not a production OS.

releases.name: MayOS × 夏日未寄：双内核原生移植预览 r1
releases.body:
# 夏日未寄 — MayOS 双内核原生移植预览 r1

Based on the exact tested **MayOS 0.4.0-pre9 development snapshot**.
This game-specific preview is **not** a replacement for the latest
numbered MayOS release.

**Original game:** https://github.com/ZhongYeMay/galgame
**MayOS source:** https://github.com/ZhongYeMay/MayOS

- Native 1024x768 QEMU visual novel app for MayKernel x86 and
  MayOS Linux 7.3.1 x86_64.
- All 97 original story nodes, 3 routes, 6 standard endings.
- All 12 original generated AI WebP backgrounds and character
  expression images reproduced as native indexed framebuffer art.
- Keyboard/mouse story choices, dialogue advance, gallery, backlog,
  autoplay, 3 save/load slots and desktop launcher.
- MayKernel: MayFS saves survive cold reboots with writable virtual disk.
- Linux: saves remain available only within the current RAM session.
- Successful real QEMU custom-kernel ISO tests, dual-kernel BIOS and
  UEFI boots, and actual GUI game input/save verification on each kernel.
- Bundled images are built into both ISO files and game does not need
  a network connection at runtime.

**Not included:** HTML/CSS/JS browser runtime, audio/BGM, animated
web transitions, optional mature epilogues or physical PC support.
Previews and tests run in QEMU, not on a real physical computer.

Attachments include native MayKernel ISO, dual-kernel BIOS/UEFI ISO,
authentic QEMU screenshots for both kernels, exact tested source
archive, source provenance manifest, porting notes and SHA256SUMS.

releases.name: MayOS 0.4.0-pre3
releases.body:
# MayOS 0.4.0-pre3

Experimental QEMU-only MayKernel / Linux 7.3.1 desktop preview.

## Browser
- Redesigned Material 3 browser with four independent tabs, native
  top tabstrip, address bar, back/forward, reload and home.
- Session bookmarks, HTTP reading mode, clickable HTML anchors,
  UTF-8 text, in-page search, page scrolling and error messages.
- Keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+L/T/W/F/R.
- MayKernel: experimental RTL8139 DHCP/IPv4/TCP/HTTP.
- Linux: e1000 DHCP/DNS and IPv4 HTTP.

Browser limitations: This is a native HTTP HTML-to-text reader, not
Chromium/Firefox/WebKit. HTTPS/TLS, CSS layout, JavaScript execution,
media playback, arbitrary modern websites and browser extensions
are not implemented. HTTPS is refused, not insecurely downgraded.

## Test results
Native MayKernel browser integration and UI/disk/network regression;
Linux and MayKernel BIOS/UEFI boot; and real full-feature QEMU
recordings must all pass before this preview becomes available.

Two ISO images, two downloadable real QEMU walkthrough MP4s, their
JSON/ISO SHA-256 checksums, a screenshot and matching MayOS source are
attached. Earlier GitHub Releases are unchanged.

This is a 1024x768 CPU framebuffer experiment, not suitable for
normal physical hardware or production use. Linux upstream and
BusyBox source/attribution instructions are in the source archive.

releases.name: MayOS 0.4.0-pre2
releases.body:
# MayOS 0.4.0-pre2

This preview preserves the pre1 kernels and network features while
refining the native Material Design 3 desktop. Changes:
- Windows-style white mouse pointer with dark outline and shadow.
- Top-right system status is entirely icon-based; text navigation
  remains on the left side of the menu bar.
- Functional clock, network, brightness, notifications, power and
  quick-settings entry points.
- Refined grayscale window shadows/controls, Dock hover feedback,
  application icons and desktop selection.
- Twenty official Apache-licensed Material Symbols Rounded icons,
  rasterized into the native kernel framebuffer at build time.

GitHub Actions verified MayKernel GUI, cursor pixel output, disk
isolation, DHCP/ARP/ICMP/DNS/TCP/HTTP, and both Linux 7.3.1 and
MayKernel BIOS/UEFI QEMU boot modes. The ISO binaries and screenshot
assets are copied from the exact successful validation run.

Experimental QEMU x86/x86_64 operating system (1024x768 CPU framebuffer).
No audio mixer, Wi-Fi manager, HTTPS/TLS browser, GPU acceleration,
Secure Boot or broad physical PC support. Linux session files are
temporary; MayKernel MayFS persists files.

Includes two ISO images, screenshots, source archive and SHA256SUMS.txt.
Third-party source and license requirements are documented in
MayOS_0.3.0-pre1/linux/README.md within the source archive.

releases.name: MayOS 0.4.0-pre1
releases.body:
# MayOS 0.4.0-pre1

First verified 0.4.0 preview. Native Material 3 desktop with macOS-like
top menu and Dock, native Material Symbols Rounded icons, application
drawer, window overview, file management, notifications and quick settings.

Native MayKernel RTL8139: DHCP, ARP, ICMP, DNS and limited TCP/HTTP text
preview. Linux 7.3.1: Ethernet DHCP/DNS and HTTP text preview.

Validated native GUI/network tests and Linux/MayKernel BIOS/UEFI QEMU
boot tests from the exact source revision for this preview.

Experimental QEMU system: 1024x768 CPU framebuffer, no Secure Boot,
HTTPS, Wi-Fi manager, arbitrary physical hardware or audio mixer.
Linux desktop files are RAM-only. Do not use on production devices.

Native and dual-kernel ISO SHA-256 checksums are in SHA256SUMS.txt.
Project source is attached. Third-party upstream kernel sources and
corresponding licenses are described in linux/README.md in the
project source tree.

releases.name: MayOS 0.3.0
releases.body:
# MayOS 0.3.0
Stable release candidate validated by GitHub Actions on Ubuntu 24.04.

- Material Design 3-inspired shared desktop UI, tonal dark/light
  themes, navigation, controls and locally drawn outline icons.
- MayKernel x86 and Linux 7.3.1 x86_64 dual boot via GRUB.
- Basic Linux Ethernet (QEMU e1000), DHCP, DNS, IP/route diagnostics
  via MayShell `net` and limited `http://` text preview in Explorer.
- BIOS and UEFI QEMU boot checks, GUI/input tests, and MayFS disk isolation.

**Known limits:** No HTTPS/TLS browser, Wi-Fi manager or MayKernel
TCP/IP stack. Secure Boot and physical hardware have not been validated.
This is still an experimental operating system; back up any important files.

The dual-boot ISO is the primary download. Check its SHA-256 against
`SHA256SUMS.txt`. Historical Releases are preserved.

releases.name: MayOS 0.3.0-pre1 · source update 1 (no ISO)
releases.body:
## MayOS 0.3.0-pre1 · Source update 1 (development prerelease)

**Source-only development snapshot. No updated bootable ISO or new QEMU recordings are included.**

Changes since the historical MayOS 0.3.0-pre1 binary:
- Ubuntu-like aubergine windows, orange controls and a less cartoonish interface.
- Real Fastfetch executable integration for the Linux x86_64 boot environment.
- Optimized native XRGB8888 scanline copying in the Linux framebuffer backend.
- Updated responsive MayOS website source and corrected release documentation.
- Old MayOS 0.1 / 0.2 files removed from the current working tree; history remains.

Existing tests: MayKernel QEMU regression suite, Linux desktop build and real Fastfetch execution passed in the source CI. **The new Linux dual-boot ISO itself has NOT been built or boot-tested in this release.**

The archive contains the source code, scripts, website and notices. Read the build instructions in `MayOS_0.3.0-pre1/README.md`. Original Linux/GRUB/BusyBox third-party sources must be obtained/provided as documented when distributing a rebuilt ISO.

MayOS Team 2023 - 2026.
This version of MayOS is for test use only.
